text:
Maria: Heads-up — planning header-split flip for router to v2.4 tomorrow 03:00 UTC. This touches API header parsing (small enum), runtime kernel change (kv-cache passive eviction), and console/pools UI for pinned variants. Any blockers?
Jordan: Can we do traffic canary? propose 5% EU first, monitor, then 25/50/100 over 15m steps. Also need API to advertise backward-compatible enum mapping.
Lin: Runtime compatibility looks ok with v2.4 if we keep kv-eviction config unchanged. Will run a quick perf smoke today.
deploy-bot: PRE-FLIGHT: scheduled job created. Command: `deploybot schedule --service router --version v2.4 --window 2026-03-24T03:00Z/04:00Z --canary 5,25,50 --regions eu,us` :white_check_mark:
Priya: Console needs a small UX change to surface pinned variant; I can ship a minor patch by EOD, but it won't be in prod until after 20:00 UTC. That means we should not rely on console pinning UX for the initial flip.
Oliver: If console isn't ready, can we do the pin via api-only config (infra flag)?
Jordan: Yes, infra can set the variant pin. @Oliver, can you coordinate with infra?
Oliver: On it — I'll open infra ticket and ask infra@ for a manual pin during the window.
Maria: Rollback criteria proposal: error rate > 1.5% for 5m or p50 latency increase > 200ms sustained for 5m OR 3% drop in qps for 10m. Agree?
Priya: +1 on metrics. Add console error spikes (500s) as a trigger.
sre-oncall: We'll watch SLO dashboard. I'll create a couple of alert runbooks and set an ops channel.
Lin: Smoke results: small 2% improved throughput on local perf; no eviction regressions in 1k-user sim.
Jordan: OK let's proceed with canary plan. Maria — want me to run the canary commands and monitor?
Maria: Yes, please. Jordan run and post the canary token/status here. If anything unexpected, we abort and roll back to v2.3.
deploy-bot: CANARY STARTED: router v2.4 -> 5% in eu. track: https://deploys.redwood.dev/1798889999
Jordan: canary token: abc123. initial health OK. p50: 78ms, errors: 0.3% :thumbsup:
Maria: Cool — keep updates in this thread. I'll update release notes: https://docs.redwood.dev/release-notes/2026-03-24-router-v2.4
Oliver: infra ticket #INF-482 created to apply pin if needed.
Priya: Adding a contingency: if console UX breaks, we'll pause and fall back to infra pin + alert customers.
Maria: Thanks all. Post-mortem owners: runtime=Lin, api=Jordan, console=Priya, infra=Oliver. Standby at 02:30 UTC.
